sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was held flat (comparable restaurant sales 'about flat' for 2026) despite a year of negative comps (-1.7% full year, -2.5% Q4), and management explicitly guided margins lower for 2026, citing a deliberate decision to underprice inflation ('we do not expect it will fully offset inflation in the near term'). The Q&A confirmed the pricing-inflation gap will be a ~150 basis point margin headwind for the full year, and management conceded the gap is 'at its widest point in the first quarter' before narrowing. While management expressed confidence in the long-term strategy, the forward outlook is flat-to-cautious with an explicit margin decline, which is a negative signal relative to the company's own prior performance.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 total revenue increased 4.9% year over year to $3.0 billion. Full year 2025 total revenue increased 5.4% to $11.9 billion.
summary.eps: Q4 2025 diluted EPS was $0.25, a 4.2% increase from $0.24 in Q4 2024. Adjusted diluted EPS remained flat at $0.25. Full year 2025 diluted EPS was $1.14, a 2.7% increase from $1.11. Adjusted diluted EPS was $1.17, a 4.5% increase from $1.12.
summary.guidance: For 2026, management anticipates full year comparable restaurant sales to be about flat, 350 to 370 new restaurant openings (including 10 to 15 international partner-operated restaurants), around 80% of company-owned restaurants with a Chipotlane, and an underlying effective full year tax rate between 24% and 26% before discrete items.
summary.margin: Q4 2025 operating margin was 14.1%, a decrease from 14.6% in Q4 2024. Restaurant level operating margin was 23.4%, a decrease from 24.8%. Full year 2025 operating margin was 16.2%, a decrease from 16.9%. Restaurant level operating margin was 25.4%, a decrease from 26.7%.
key_risks: Comparable restaurant sales decreased 2.5% in Q4 and 1.7% for the full year, driven by lower transactions.
Inflation, primarily in beef and chicken, and the impact from tariffs enacted in 2025 increased food costs.
Wage inflation and lower sales volumes increased labor costs.
Management expects margins to be under pressure in 2026 due to taking less price compared to inflation, with a ~150 basis point margin headwind for the full year.
The pricing-inflation gap is expected to be at its widest point in the first quarter of 2026.
France is a challenging market due to wage inflation and occupancy costs, with recovery not at the same pace as other markets.
The company is conducting a national search for a Chief Marketing Officer, which could imply some disruption risk.
key_opportunities: The 'Recipe for Growth' strategy aims to grow transactions and drive accuracy, efficiency, and speed.

High-efficiency equipment package rollout is showing 'hundreds of basis points of improvement in comp sales' in restaurants with the package, with plans to have 2,000 restaurants equipped by year-end.
High-protein menu launch has shown early success, with incidence of extra protein increasing 35% and a record digital sales day during a double protein promotion.
Group occasions (Build Your Own Chipotle and catering) represent less than 3% of combined sales but could be a double-digit percentage of sales longer term.
Rewards program relaunch planned for spring 2026, targeting in-restaurant guests, with active members growing to over 21 million.
Global expansion: record 345 new restaurants opened in 2025, with plans to nearly double Middle East footprint in 2026 and enter new markets like Mexico, Singapore, and South Korea.
Long-term goal of reaching 7,000 restaurants in North America.

management_tone.label: optimistic
management_tone.justification: Management expressed deep confidence in the brand and strategy ('I've never been more confident in the strength of this brand and our ability to win') while acknowledging near-term margin pressure and a flat comp outlook, reflecting optimism about the long-term trajectory despite near-term challenges.

review_flags.reason: The score is negative (-0.20) driven by flat guidance and explicit margin pressure, but management's confident long-term language and multiple growth initiatives could be interpreted as more balanced. A human reviewer should verify the weighting of the margin headwind versus the growth opportunities.
The CMO search is listed as a risk, but the document frames it as a 'chapter change' with strong internal and external candidates. This may be more of a neutral transition than a risk.
